vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Dmitri was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Dmitri showed Mario the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
🛡️ Violet, Mario, Benoit, Ursula and David met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Violet, Mario, Ursula, David are hurt.
Silvia showed Jorge the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
🛡️ Esmeralda, Mario, Benoit, Ursula and David met them at the door — 5 put down. Esmeralda, Mario, Benoit, Ursula, David are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jorge just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mario, Silvia, Salim, Benoit and Jorge met them at the door — 5 put down. Mario, Silvia, Salim, Benoit, Jorge are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Esmeralda just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jorge just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Silvia just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Salim just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Silvia, Salim, Benoit, David and Wei met them at the door — 5 put down. Silvia, Salim, Benoit, David, Wei are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mario just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mario, Silvia, Benoit and Ursula met them at the door — 4 put down. Mario, Silvia, Ursula are hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fabio just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Fabio met them at the door — 1 put down. Fabio is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Benoit just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
